query:
SELECT 
  id, auditId, jobId, url, domain, status, overallScore,
  citationCount, rank, createdAt, completedAt,
  LENGTH(findings) as findings_len
FROM competitor_audits
WHERE auditId = 3450003
ORDER BY createdAt DESC;
